question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `mcp.servers.*.oauth.authProfileId` and materialize its current access token into local-only Codex app-server MCP config?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but this creates a public config contract and intentionally expands which local process receives OAuth access-token material; repository history and CI cannot substitute for owner intent.

options.title: Accept The Scoped Boundary
options.body: Approve the selector and local-only bearer projection as supported contracts, retaining remote fail-closed behavior and never projecting refresh tokens.

options.title: Redesign Credential Ownership
options.body: Keep the PR open while replacing literal token projection with a narrower credential handoff owned by Codex or another approved runtime seam.

recommendation.title: Accept The Scoped Boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the selector and local-only bearer projection as supported contracts, retaining remote fail-closed behavior and never projecting refresh tokens.
